verdict.rationale: Omnara is open source under Apache 2.0 and explicitly free to self-host. The GitHub README references self-hosted deployments backed by Postgres, and agents can run on a machine you connect, such as a laptop or server, without opening inbound ports. That covers self-hosting locally and on your own servers or VMs. Community worries about data reaching a third party are general skepticism, not concrete evidence that self-hosting fails. Missing for 10: explicit container/Docker deployment documentation, a detailed self-hosting install guide, and independent hands-on corroboration of a self-hosted setup.
